thread:
Jordan H: Hey everyone, first day here! :wave: Quick IT hiccups — my monitor shipped but the stand bracket is cracked, and my USB-C->Ethernet dongle is missing from the box. Wi‑Fi works but I can’t connect to corp VPN (SSO gives a 403). Who should I ping to get a replacement dock/dongle and help with VPN?
IT Support: Welcome, Jordan — congrats and welcome aboard! :tada: Can you drop a photo of the cracked bracket here? We’ll open a replacement ticket once we have the pic. For the dongle we can overnight a replacement.
Jordan H: Uploading photo now — attaching 2 pics. Also, do I need to enroll the laptop in MDM before VPN will work?
IT Support: Got the photos — thanks. Ticket created: IT-218403. Replacement dock + dongle scheduled for next‑day shipping (tracking will be emailed). Regarding VPN: we require device enrollment for full corporate VPN. If you haven’t enrolled yet, try this quick check: open the MDM agent (Settings → Company Devices) and confirm enrollment status. If it shows un-enrolled, reply and we’ll push the profile.
Jordan H: MDM says "pending". Do you want me to try to re-run the agent or wait?
IT Support: Try re-running the enroll flow first. If that errors, send us the MDM log: open terminal and run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output. If it still shows pending we’ll push a force-enroll.
Jordan H: Ran the command, got "No enrolled profiles" and an error about missing management token. Pasting the small log: "enrollment: failed - token not found"
IT Support: Thanks — we’ll push a new enrollment token. One sec... pushed. Try the enroll flow again and then attempt VPN.
Jordan H: Enrollment succeeded! VPN now connects. Huge relief. :sweat_smile:
Samira P: Hi Jordan — welcome to Platform team! If you need quick ramp materials, check the onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood/platform-onboarding and DM me and I’ll walk you through team access.
Maya L: Welcome! Also FYI the monitor stand replacement might be a slightly different color (vendor stock), hopefully that’s OK. 
Jordan H: All good — color totally fine. Thanks everyone for the quick help. One last question: should I expect any hardware receipts or forms to sign for the replacement?
IT Support: No receipts needed for replacing defective items. We’ll update asset records and forward any necessary acceptance emails. If you keep the damaged bracket for recycling, mark it "returned - defect" in the asset portal.
DevEx Bot: Reminder — new-hires channel orientation at 3pm today in #all-hands; calendar invite sent. :bell:
Jordan H: Perfect, I’ll be there. Thanks again!
IT Support: Closing the thread for now — will update IT-218403 when replacement ships. Ping us if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
